Careers

Kramer is a place where people, ideas and technology come together, creating engaging connections, vibrant experiences, and real human impact.

Current openings

Why work at kramer?

Anyone can take the initiative and make things happen at Kramer. With +20 global offices and hybrid work models, we empower people with infinite ways to engage and positively impact the world!

The perks of working at kramer

As a company, we know how valuable our employees are, and we believe that talented employees deserve substantial benefits. All employees receive a generous benefits package to ensure they have everything they need – and more. Here’s what you can expect:

  • A positive working environment
  • Hybrid work model
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Health insurance program
  • Ongoing learning culture
  • Comprehensive wellness benefits
  • And much more!



*Some benefits are subject to applicable local guidelines and may vary between countries.

Our culture

We don’t believe in closed doors or outdated hierarchies, because diversity and transparency are essential for cutting edge problem solving.
